hypotheses.reasoning: At 20:41:33 an auth-svc-reconciler transaction (85871) sat idle in transaction while holding RowExclusiveLock on accounts (#199). After that, the login-path UPDATEs in auth-svc queued behind it waiting for ShareLock (#205, #214) and then hit the 10s statement timeout (#210, #218, #221). That made account-svc's AuthClient.issueToken calls time out after 15s (#211). The account-svc pool to auth-svc then filled to 50/50 and checkouts timed out (#223, #235, #247), and edge-proxy returned 504s on POST /login. Before 20:41 logins were healthy at about 100ms. I found no deploy or version change in the window, and the 400 at #72 is unrelated input validation.
The account-svc pool to auth-svc was saturated. But it only saturated because calls were hanging on the DB lock, so this is a symptom, not the cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: In accounts-db, terminate the idle-in-transaction reconciler session holding transaction 85871 (pg_terminate_backend). Then fix auth-svc-reconciler so it commits or rolls back promptly, and set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout on accounts-db. Once that's done, check that the account-svc pool to auth-svc drains and /login latency is back to normal.
